_source.why: xeno-acp keeps its release notes in docs/CHANGELOG-XACP.md, not in a RELEASE_NOTES module, so this file is the notes source publish-cli-releases.mjs reads for the acp slug. Update it from the product CHANGELOG when a new version is published.
_source.note: 0.1.0 is deliberately absent. It is already live in apps/acp/releases.json and is preserved by the publisher's merge; re-deriving it here would overwrite the authored launch entry with a weaker one.

0.2.14.title: Native provider tool-event mirroring
notes: Follows persisted Codex and Claude provider transcripts and emits structured native tool-start, completion, and failure events to the owning Host conversation.
Correlates tool calls with their results, bounds and redacts previews, suppresses replayed history, and never scrapes terminal pixels.
Preserves provider-native session identity so the native TUI and graphical Agent surface remain two live views of the same execution.

0.2.5.title: Lossless continuation state and secret-safe packaging
notes: Resolves @xenosystem/agent-sdk 0.9.16 so ACP sessions inherit lossless concurrent recent-session updates, XENO_AGENT_HOME isolation, and final PowerShell stdout draining.
Keeps the deterministic stderr-redaction fixture secret-shaped at runtime without embedding a static credential-shaped string in shipped artifacts.
Retains the packaged ACP CLI, provider policy, and stdio initialization contract introduced in 0.2.4.

0.2.4.title: Runnable ACP package and unbounded continuation
notes: Ships the complete runnable ACP agent runtime, including provider-policy templates and every asset required by the installed CLI.
Consumes @xenosystem/agent-sdk 0.9.15 so ACP sessions inherit durable recent-session indexing and unbounded managed-operation continuation.
Verifies all four public packages as isolated registry-shaped artifacts before publication.

0.1.1.title: npm scope migration to @xenosystem
notes: The four ACP packages now publish under the @xenosystem npm scope. Identity-only: no runtime behaviour, export, CLI contract or supported-target claim changed.
@xeno-corporation/xeno-acp is now @xenosystem/acp (the xeno-acp binary is unchanged).
@xeno-corporation/xeno-acp-agent is now @xenosystem/acp-agent (the xeno-acp-agent binary is unchanged).
The acp- family prefix is deliberately kept: flattening it would collide @xenosystem/acp-core with the rendering engine's @xenosystem/core.
The version moved to 0.1.1 because a 0.1.0 tarball already exists under each old name — two different tarballs must never share a version string across a rename.
Supported launch targets are unchanged: Windows and Linux with Node.js 20 or newer.
